notes:
Intro: inbound self-serve sign-up, used free credits, then opened ticket re: "slow responses" on support chat. 

Summary: SMB ecommerce platform that uses hosted API for order-status chat + canned returns flow. Heavy peak windows around 11am-1pm EST. Mostly in NA but many EU customers — they routed calls to EU by default (region mismatch). Early discovery: interested in hosted_api, low ops overhead. Cost-sensitive; wants guidance to keep RPS and token costs low.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-01-20: signup via marketing landing page (free credits). auto-welcome flow.
- 2026-02-02: first test traffic, quick spike exposes higher latencies for some EU requests.
- 2026-02-25: support ticket RDW-9981 opened: "chat responses time out sometimes, UI shows partial spinner".
- 2026-03-03: 30m call w/ Aisha + Diego + engineering lead (Fireflies ff_20260303_02_copperpike_call). Notes attached.
- 2026-03-08: engineering ran region comparison: NA (us-east) median latency 110ms; EU (eu-west) median 360ms under same token load.

Key technical points observed / customer constraints:
- Default region selection: their client SDK was using eu-west for EU dataset; unhappy because many of their inventory API services live in us-east, adding cross-region hop.
- Timeouts: frontend default timeout is 3s; on bigger prompts / longer history responses are aborted. They want recommended timeout increments.
- Prompts: templates include full order history dump (3-4KB) on each call — big token blowup. They asked for prompt-length guidance and caching suggestions.
- Burst behavior: peaks cause request queueing; no batching at client side. They are novice on batching configs.

What we recommended on call (actionable, quick wins):
- Switch EU traffic to us-east for now for their main flows that hit their origin services in us-east. Quick A/B test to confirm latency improvement. (Diego to supply region routing snippet).
- Increase client timeout to 8s for chat flows with history. Explain tradeoffs: longer SLOs vs. UX.
- Trim prompt context: recommend truncating order-history to last 3 events + canonicalized customer note. Offer to share sample prompt templates (we have one).
- Enable prefix KV caching for repeat prompts (suggest Redwood Optimize suggestions after they reach usage threshold).
- Recommend smaller model variant for routine confirmations (e.g., fast-*-v1) and reserve larger variant for intent parsing only.

POC plan suggested (lightweight):
- Week 0: apply region switch + increase timeout to 8s in staging. Monitor 1-week median latency.
- Week 1: implement prompt trimming and enable client-side rate limit to smooth bursts.
- Week 2: A/B test model routing (fast variant vs default) for 10% traffic. Evaluate token cost delta.

Quotes & customer voice:
- "Responses feel choppy for our EU users — sometimes the chat just stops and the spinner sits there." — Lead Eng
- "We want quick fixes first, then look at cost tradeoffs." — Product Manager

Open items / blockers:
- Need engineering time to change region and shipping config (small but currently low bandwidth).
- Legal asked about data residency but customer clarified order metadata is non-PII and SOC2 + audit logs suffice for now.
- Budget: will likely start with a 6-month small commit if perf improves.

Next steps (owner):
- Diego to send region-switch snippet + client timeout patch before 2026-03-14.
- Aisha to share prompt-trimming templates + dashboard query for latency by region.
- Schedule 30m re-test call week of 2026-03-22 (owner: Aisha).

Stance: good fit for hosted_api -> low friction; likely to convert if latency fixed and basic cost guidance provided. Keep contact cadence light, provide clear perf checklist they can apply without heavy infra changes.
